protocol: Three fresh navigations in the same in-app browser. First run is cold; runs two and three form the warm mean. Cross-origin Supabase byte sizes are unavailable without Timing-Allow-Origin.

publicLanding.conclusion: Statistically flat. The warm LCP changed by 4 ms; the observable encoded payload grew 1.6% for the added UI assets. No performance improvement is claimed.

authenticatedRoutes.reason: The isolated production browser had no authenticated PeerGrid session. Protected pages correctly redirected to the public landing page and the stale-cookie path produced no console error.
